name: c-relation-explorer
description: Build-free C references, caller/callee graphs and a linked Context preview.

commands.title: C Relations: Open Relation and Context

enumDescriptions: Sort Callees by their first call location in source, not runtime execution order.
cRelation.calleeSort.description: Callees sorting. Also available from the Relation right-click menu. Callers and References keep name order.

enumDescriptions: Show Context as an independent Explorer view; drag its header to move it.
cRelation.contextLayout.description: Context layout. Also available from the Relation right-click menu. Separate Context shares the same analysis and selection.

cRelation.include.description: Workspace-relative glob patterns to include in C/H analysis, for example App/** or Drivers/**. Empty includes all C/H files. Exclude always takes priority. Uses forward slashes. Changes automatically rebuild the index.

cRelation.exclude.description: Workspace-relative glob patterns excluded from indexing and file watching, for example **/Tools/Polyspace/**. Exclude takes priority over Include. Uses forward slashes. Changes automatically rebuild the index. Independent of files.exclude, search.exclude and C_Cpp.files.exclude.

cRelation.skipInactive.description: Exclude provably inactive #if 0/1 branches. Unknown conditions remain visible.

cRelation.automaticUpdates.description: Check GitHub Releases daily and ask before installing a newer version.

scripts.test: tsx --test test/core.test.ts test/macros.test.ts test/pointer-calls.test.ts test/members.test.ts test/syntax.test.ts test/updates.test.ts
scripts.test:ui: npm run build && tsx test/create-ui-fixture.ts && node test/ui.mjs
